verdict.rationale: Kimi offers an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible model API with self-serve keys, plus a CLI and ACP integration, so core chat and coding-agent use can be driven programmatically. However, the probe found no public API for the assistant app itself (the Open Platform is a separate product), and the API reportedly has fixed parameters, no public image URLs and limited web search. UI features such as PPT assistant, deep research, memory, scheduled tasks, web-page agent deployment and Kimi Claw have no API equivalent in evidence. Missing for 10: an assistant-app API, API access to PPT/deep research/memory/scheduled tasks/agent-swarm/Claw features, full parameter parity with the UI, and documentation of UI-to-API coverage.
